facts.text: I am trying to get my sports gear in order.
I want to get my road bike serviced around downtown.

I need to get knee pads.

I need to get my yoga mat back from my friend Rachel.
I want yoga mats that are eco-friendly and non-slip.
I have been meaning to get my swim goggles' straps replaced.
I want to know whether I can replace swim goggles' straps myself or if I need a professional.
